title: fix(metadata)!: the unscoped plural read counts an action name's holders per (object, name), so the boot pass keeps a package-less row on another object beside the holder's
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Fixes #32681

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作（`action`）的无包行在非限定的复数读取（`pluralEntryKeys`，`loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` / `DatabaseLoader` 的非限定读取共用）里，按 `(对象, 名字)` 数持有者：只有当名字唯一的持有包也把该名字绑在同一个对象上时，无包行才并入它（它的定制）；绑在没人绑的对象上的无包行是环境自己的条目，单独保留。
- 为什么改：席位裁决 A（2026-11-14T16:12Z）的后一半。之前 ALPHA 把 `approve` 绑在 `account`、一条无包行绑在 `contact` 时，复数读取按名字把两行并成一条、只留最后保存的那行，启动预载后注册表只剩一个；点名 ALPHA 的读取在预载后答出 `contact` 行（ALPHA 从没声明过的绑定），而冷读答 ALPHA 自己的 `account` 行。只有 BETA 绑 `contact`、无包行在 `account` 时同理。
- 风险与回滚：只影响接了 `DatabaseLoader` 的宿主（工作区内 0 处）；库里的行不改不迁移，只改复数读取保留哪些行、预载注册哪些；同一对象上的单持有者、两个包持有同名的情形不变；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `pluralEntryKeys`（风险 hunk：`customizes` 判定）与新 helper `entryIdentitiesOf`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t "counts an action name"`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Second half of seat ruling A on #32681 (ADR-0150 D4: an action is keyed by `(package, objectName, name)`). The first half (#33318) keyed `DatabaseLoader`'s saves and slot reads per `(object, name)`; this one does the same for the unscoped plural read, now that #33299's keyed-entry stamping is on `main`.

`pluralEntryKeys` (`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`) is the key `MetadataManager.loadMany`, `MetadataManager.loadManyKeyed` and `DatabaseLoader`'s unscoped reads keep one entry per. For `action`, an entry that carries no package is now folded into the name's one holder only when that holder binds the name to the entry's own object (or both are object-less): the holders of the entry's `(object, name)`, counted from the row's `bundle_member` column first, else its body's object, through a new helper `entryIdentitiesOf` that `pluralEntryCustomizedHolders` now shares. Bound to an object no package binds the name to, the row is the environment's own entry and keeps a key of its own, so the boot priming pass registers it beside the holder's item and the store's `(object, name)` write rule files it in the bare slot.

Every moved answer, FROM to TO (host wiring a `DatabaseLoader`; stored rows; `approve` the action name):

| Shape | Answer | FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ALPHA on `account`, a package-less row on `contact` | plural read (`loadMany`) | one entry, the row saved last | both |
| same | registry after the boot pass | `contact` key alone (package-less saved last) / ALPHA's `account` key alone (saved first) | ALPHA's `account` key and the `contact` key |
| same, package-less row saved last | read naming ALPHA after the pass | the `contact` row | ALPHA's `account` item, as without the pass |
| BETA on `contact` alone, a package-less row on `account` | plural read; registry after the pass | one entry; one key | both; BETA's `contact` key and the `account` key |
| same, package-less row saved last | read naming BETA after the pass | the `account` row | BETA's `contact` item, as without the pass |
| ALPHA on `account` + a package-less object-less row; ALPHA object-less + a package-less row on `account` | plural read; registry; reads after the pass | one entry, one key | both, both keys, reads equal to the reads without the pass |

The narrowing: after the boot pass, a read naming a package no longer reaches a package-less row bound to an object that package never bound the name to.

Re-measured with #33299 merged: the fold no longer loosens a read naming BETA into ALPHA's item. In the mirror shape, a read naming BETA (which holds nothing) answers the environment's `contact` row before and after the pass, in both version orders, and never ALPHA's.

Not changed: a name one package holds on one object beside a package-less row on that object (one entry, the row saved last); a name two packages hold (the package-less row keeps its own entry and `pluralEntryCustomizedHolders` names the holder it customizes, as in #33318); the `/actions/OBJECT/NAME` route's declaration read (see Acceptance notes); types other than `action`; stored rows (no migration).

## Tests

- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, describe `[#32681] the plural read counts an action name's holders per (object, name)…` (11 cases): four moved shapes in both version orders (plural read entries, cold reads, registry keys after the real `MetadataPlugin` boot pass, reads after the pass equal to the cold reads, no row updated); CONTROL one package on one object (both orders: one entry, the one saved last, its key); CONTROL two packages on one object (three entries, bare read refused naming both and the environment, before and after the pass).
- Moved pin: `[#32791]` "a package's row bound to an object and an object-less package-less row saved last" — the registry now holds ALPHA's `account` key beside the bare slot (FROM the bare slot alone); the bare reads are unchanged.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, describe `[#32681] /actions/account/approve…` (4 new cases): mirror shape and single-holder cell, both save orders, over the writable `sys_metadata` double, the real `MetadataPlugin` boot pass and the protocol: registry holds both keys, a read naming the holder answers its own item, and the package-less row's route judges that item and runs the environment's handler.

## Acceptance notes

- The holder's own route (`/actions/account/approve` in the mirror shape, `/actions/contact/approve` in the single-holder cell) still judges no declaration, before and after this change alike (measured both ways, the metadata fix ablated and rebuilt): its declaration read is the protocol's execution face (`getMetaItemForExecution`), which beside one package holder answers the environment's item on the other object (`judgeBareActionRead` keeps main's answer on that face); the route then sees another object's action. That face is in `packages/metadata-protocol` (area E1), where #32551 records it as followed up by its owner seat; filed as #33456 (lease:E1). The route of the package-less row's object judges and runs that one item (pinned).
- On the same route the environment's item is served with the holder's `_packageId` and `_provenance: 'package'` (the protocol's artifact envelope lookup goes by name, not `(object, name)`); the route's own `packageId` is unset and the environment's handler runs. Measured in the runtime harness, also area E1, carried by #33456.
- With one package holding the name on one object and a package-less row on that same object, the read naming the package without the pass answers the package's own row, while after the pass it answers the package-less row when that row was saved last (saved first, the pass registers the package's row alone). That fold (one entry per `(package, name)`, the row saved last) is unchanged here and pinned as a CONTROL.
- No change in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**`, `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` or `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

At 8efae7e95f (after merging `origin/main` with #33193): `@objectstack/metadata` test 78/78 files, 2423 tests; `@objectstack/objectql` 595/595 files, 12978 tests; `@objectstack/runtime` 599/599 files, 10707 passed, 19 skipped; metadata and runtime typecheck exit 0; eslint on the three changed source/test files exit 0; dogfood battery 466 passed / 3 skipped files, 3944 passed / 42 skipped tests. Derived gates: 59 families, 58 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, no full dist in the worktree; CI Build Core covers it); `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 59/59.

Ablation (the `customizes` line mutated back to the by-name fold through `ablation-replace.mjs`, metadata rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0): metadata 8 moved cases red, every CONTROL and the first half's 11 cases green; runtime 4 of 4 new cases red (registry held one key). Route answers in that state equal the fixed state's (holder's route: no declaration; package-less row's route: that item, environment's handler). Restored to the HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty), metadata rebuilt, fix marker back in `dist/`.
</details>
